'''Hirang Birren''' was a [[Nithorn]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a cruise [[Starship|ship]] talent scout and spent [[time]] on the [[yacht]] ''[[First Light]]'' in [[10 BBY]]. While aboard, he began singing along with [[Musician|performers]] [[Aurodia Ventafoli]] and [[Luleo Primoc]] in his own [[Language|guttural birdsong]].

==Biography==
The [[Nithorn]]<ref name="SoloOG" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Creatures" /> Hirang Birren worked as a cruise [[Starship|ship]] talent scout during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events aboard the ''[[First Light]]'' in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[10 BBY]].</ref> Birren was attending a party aboard the ''[[First Light]]''—the personal [[yacht]] of [[Dryden Vos]], [[Crime lord|leader]] of the [[Crimson Dawn]] criminal organization—when it arrived on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]].<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

While on the starship, Birren listened to a [[music]]al performance by the [[Musician|singers]] [[Aurodia Ventafoli]] and [[Luleo Primoc]], and unwittingly began singing along with them in his own [[Language|guttural birdsong]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> With a drink in [[Limb|hand]] and a [[human]] woman on his arm, Birren walked past the outlaw [[Han Solo]] on the yacht's<ref name="Solo" /> viewing platform.<ref name="SoloOG" /> He then stood with the woman at one of the platform's [[Viewport|windows]] to talk.<ref name="Solo" />

==Personality and traits==
Birren had a keen [[ear]] for music. He had [[Color|brown]]-and-green skin and black [[eye]]s, as well as a recumbent crest of brown feathers with black stripes.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Equipment==
During his time aboard the yacht ''First Light'', Birren wore a black [[Clothing|jacket]] over a yellow shirt, with black pants and [[Clothing|shoes]].<ref name="Solo" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Chris Clarke, who built the mechanics of the head, performed the face and puppeteer Colin Purves was in my ear giving me directions, as my vision was very limited. I was thrilled that the character is named anagramically after me!|Brian Herring|<ref name="Creatures" />}}
[[File:Maverick_015_Version_1A.png|thumb|right|175px|Nithorn concept art for ''Solo: A Star Wars Story'']]
Hirang Birren was portrayed by puppeteer [[Brian Herring]]<ref name="Creatures" /> in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo" /> Nithorn concept art for the film was drawn by senior sculptor [[Luke Fisher]] and titled "Maverick 015 Version A."<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> The mechanics of the Birren character's mask were built by [[Christopher Clarke|Chris Clarke]], who also controlled the mask's facial movements on set. Due to the limited vision that the mask allowed, Herring had puppeteer [[Colin Purves]] giving him directions through an earpiece during filming.<ref name="Creatures" />

On the film's set, the character was known as "parrot man."<ref name="Creatures" /> The reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released alongside the film, officially identified the character as Hirang Birren<ref name="SoloOG" />—an anagram of Herring's name.<ref name="Creatures" />
